name: io.github.klarluft/gitwarren
title: GitWarren
description: Code review on your own machine, for you and your coding agent. Nothing leaves your computer.

packageArguments.description: Run the MCP server on stdin and stdout.

packageArguments.name: --serve
packageArguments.description: Also serve the review page on 127.0.0.1 for as long as the server runs, so the links the agent hands out open on a machine with nothing else installed. Serves nothing when a GitWarren is already running here; links open there instead.

environmentVariables.name: GITWARREN_DATA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Where the review database lives. Leave unset for the platform's application-data directory, which the app and the command line also use.
